details: On Windows, JDK 21.0.11, Gradle 9.7.0, seed 18622C0DE, one test JVM, and identical Solr head 769ca6e177d77acd3f1993a4a24bd3257ae243c0 in separate clean source worktrees, TestNestedDocsSort.testFilteredChildrenDoNotSupplyMissingValues failed with stock Lucene 10.6.0 (1 test, 1 assertion failure, 0 errors, 0 skips, exit 1: expected first parent 3, actual 2) and passed with repaired Lucene join JAR from e0c53033bb2b6b34939ded24e228443b7d8b576b (1 test, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips, exit 0). An isolated local Maven repository was used for each leg with identical Maven Central POM; Gradle test classpath hash checks reported stock JAR 05bf382ecb895c01d9fc23efd8da25909aee4e6de96b13dc26bf148a2407690e and patched JAR 1d6cf07164022466858c76037a47469c17f73796112142c6059f5dbd03e6c8aa. Test JVM class-load logs independently show ToParentDocValues loaded from the appropriate stock and patched repositories. Stock XML SHA-256 3054717fe5e4c8463579f1166908c60d45e4509d05eb99b1691e39a7e482da2c, log 183994b42ed1b0fa73e74ab89f79ad9964a88c2a0ff0265121f39bf15d6d703e; patched XML d05927d01cbae995c2a0884243c867ab98cc296a82a456b7248b17be532235d7, log 3d5cfd8816952e6c577b1858ba2172a438430f2c4985ed41776acb939ca96809. Evidence lives under research/lucene-submission-prep/solr5293-windows-integration. The POM coordinates are 10.6.0 in both local repositories; the patched JAR is a locally built snapshot and must not be described as an unmodified release. Both used -PdisableJsClient=true, omitted Error Prone, and emitted security-policy locale warnings. Other methods and full suites remain pending at this report.
